Comments: NIDA (National Identification Agency) is the core identity node, integrated with at least 11 other government systems. Rwanda has biometric national ID (2008+). NIDA integration with Irembo, MINALOC, LODA, RDB, RURA documented. National Data Sharing Policy mandates unified national identifiers.

Comments: DHIS2 operational since 2012, data completeness rose from 88% to 95% and timeliness from 60% to 90%+ in key districts. National Health Intelligence Centre established for data integration. Comments: Rwanda deployed Mojaloop-based payment infrastructure (national bank-mandated interoperability). Mobile money interoperability achieved across providers. Comments: National Data Sharing Policy includes a phased implementation plan from 2025 to 2029 with defined milestones: 2025 - establish Data Governance Unit, define data standards, commence DSP project; subsequent years - DSP development, online portal, monitoring/reporting rollout. Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Rwanda Cabinet approved the National Data Sharing Policy on 26 May 2025, creating a comprehensive framework for data exchange across public institutions. Aligned with Second National Strategy for Transformation (NST2) and Vision 2050. ICT Sector Strategic Plan 2018-2024 also addresses interoperability. Rwanda Data Protection and Privacy Law (No. 058/2021) provides legal basis.

Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: Rwanda's National Health Intelligence Centre (established) uses data analytics for health decision-making. The National Data Sharing Policy (approved May 2025) references advanced analytics as an anticipated benefit. GeoHub uses satellite/AI for agriculture and planning. However, no evidence of AI specifically integrated into the data exchange platform (DSP under development).

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Rwanda has Irembo as a citizen-facing digital service platform (over 100 services, operational since 2014). NIDA is integrated with at least 11 other systems. A dedicated National Data Sharing Platform (DSP) was approved via the National Data Sharing Policy (May 2025) with phased implementation through 2029. Key milestones for 2025 include establishing the Data Governance Unit and commencing the DSP project. As of 2025 the DSP is under development, hence 3=Under Development.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Rwanda chose X-Road as open source because 'we could see all the source code and manage and control the data.' Data Protection and Privacy Law (No. 058/2021) is in force. National Data Sharing Policy includes strict personal data sharing controls with DPPL compliance. Rwanda has a national Data Protection Agency (RPPA). Rwanda cited for open-source first strategy ensuring national control.
